item.content:encoded:
This reads as a lot less stiff than when I read ot as a draft — I don't think it quite captures the ethos of the Hand still, but it's marginally improved.

I'd have to say though, I'm of the opinion that the entire silly "somebody wants to fuck it" angle really detracts from what would otherwise be a straight-faced exploration of the subject's intent and morals, and severly impacts the mythicality of the piece.
